comments.note: utils.js: ProjectNameCache uses bare `slug` as the cache key (e.g., ProjectNameCache.set(slug, name)). With multi-repo support enabled, two projects in different repos can share the same slug and will collide in the cache. The key should be a namespaced composite like `repo + '/' + slug`. The set() and get() callers are in project-list.js (WP-009) and project-detail.js (WP-013) — addressing it there is the natural fix point.

router.js: The five project route regexes repeat the two-segment capture pattern `/([^/]+)\/([^/]+)/`. A small helper like `_projectRouteRegex(suffix)` could reduce duplication and make future route additions self-documenting. Out of scope for WP-008 but worth noting.

comments.note: Edge case verified: path '/projects/repo/' (trailing slash) correctly falls through to 404 — the two-segment regex requires a non-empty second segment so [^/]+ prevents a spurious match.

Edge case verified: encodeURIComponent in breadcrumb().project() handles slashes in repo names (e.g. 'org/sub' → 'org%2Fsub'), keeping the URL unambiguous. Symmetric with decodeURIComponent in the router dispatch.
